body:
Review times for repository advisories and CVE requests are currently longer than our documentation states, and they vary with incoming volume. We are removing the turnaround estimate from the advisory page and will be updating the documentation to match. We aren't publishing a replacement estimate yet for our advisory or CVE queues, but have been sharing updates in our blog and community forums.

- https://github.blog/security/supply-chain-security/inside-the-advisory-database-and-what-happens-when-vulnerability-volume-breaks-records/
- https://github.com/orgs/community/discussions/189802

If there's a problem with the advisory itself, such as wrong versions, a missing package or a duplicate, please open a PR with those details and we'll correct it.

On your specific questions:

- **Documentation:** yes, the 72-hour wording is being removed. We're not committing to a recovery date.
- **Publishing queue stats weekly:** not at this time.
- **Declined vs. waiting:** not every repository advisory is added to the database or assigned a CVE, but we don't publish that breakdown.
